evidence.static_summary: r27: pinned toolchain build; 27 Rust host tests passed plus the mod's ARM and native suites in ./build.sh test, including fixtures that the probe tints a bound frame white once on all four corners, logs a replaced tint once and tints again on a new screen; verify: "PASS: pinned inputs, 24 hook windows, NZCVQ/GE audit, exports and payload inventory", plus the vertex-colour setter window against the pinned NSO.
evidence.manual_summary: Gameplay NOT RUN. r26 is the gameplay-accepted build for luck highlights on Eden.

limitations: r27 is a probe: it never restores a tinted frame while the reward screen stays open, and the overlay border still draws over the tinted frames
does not run on MHGURecomp: the private CodeMemory arena calls svc 0x4B, which aborts the game at load
r26 ran on Eden master-07677aa500-master with a player report for luck highlights; loading beside a foreign hook on the same entry has not been exercised and rests on Forge's hook.c and host fixtures
Gameplay evidence for r25 is one unitemized user report on Eden (2026-11-02). Ryujinx and native Switch coverage remain unconfirmed.
Individual player-page quantity, Palico exclusion, appraisal/collection, persistence and consecutive-quest checks were not separately reported.
Log contains HLE/keyboard and Maxwell assertions plus an unmapped-memory error; no clean-run or clean-shutdown claim. These emulator messages are not attributed to the plugin.
Native inventory capacity and the 150-entry appraisal queue remain; unsupported records or quantity products above 32767 suppress the entire multiplier attempt.
Ryujinx and physical Switch gameplay are untested.
Successful cache calls do not establish CPU translation freshness; the second forced check broader role remains incompletely traced.
reason: r27 probe: tints highlighted reward frames white through the native vertex-colour setter and logs their colours, to learn whether a native tint can replace the overlay.
target: MHGU Nintendo Switch 1.4.0; upstream Forge 1.5.1; Eden/Ryujinx.
